  customers."spend" AS "orders.quoted_cross",
  CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS "orders.m"
FROM orders AS orders
LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
  ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
WHERE
  orders.amount >= 0
GROUP BY
  customers."spend"

WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(orders.created_at, MONTH) AS `orders___created_at`
  FROM orders AS orders
  WHERE
    orders.created_at BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' AND orders.amount >= 0
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC(orders.created_at, MONTH)
), _cm_orders__eu_amount_sum AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(orders.created_at, MONTH) AS `orders___created_at`,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN customers.tier = 'eu' THEN orders.amount END) AS FLOAT64) AS `orders___m`
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  WHERE
    orders.created_at BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' AND orders.amount >= 0
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC(orders.created_at, MONTH)
)
SELECT
  _base.`orders___created_at`,
  _cm_orders__eu_amount_sum.`orders___m`
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_orders__eu_amount_sum
  ON _base.`orders___created_at` IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__eu_amount_sum.`orders___created_at`
